column2: Choose how much energy our industry turns into crude oil, and crude oil into fuel, each day.
Our industry can turn surplus energy into crude oil, and crude oil into fuel. Left to themselves, our engineers decide how much by our industrial capacity. Which conversion do you want to set?

How much energy should we turn into crude oil each day? We can never make more than 0.05 crude oil per IC a day this way, so a larger amount is cut to that, and the energy our industry needs today is never touched. Until we have developed a synthetic industry no energy can be turned into crude oil at all, and what is chosen here waits until then. Exact amounts and limits can be set on the utility's Resource Conversion page.
As much as our industry allows

How much crude oil should our refineries turn into fuel each day? They can never refine more than half a unit per IC a day, so a larger amount is cut to that, and how much fuel each unit makes depends on our technology and laws. Exact amounts and limits can be set on the utility's Resource Conversion page.
